title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) & Soft vs. Hard Constraints:
prompt: **Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) & Soft vs. Hard Constraints:** When enforcing partial differential equations (like the Black-Scholes PDE or Dupire local volatility equation, or Navier-Stokes) in a neural network, compare adding PDE residual penalties to the loss function vs. baking hard mathematical constraints directly into the output layer activation (e.g., using `Softplus` and cumulative sums for monotonicity/convexity).

resources.title: So, what is a physics-informed neural network?
resources.why: Soft physics constraints in the loss versus hard constraints, with worked examples.
